path parameter and verifies only the session token, not the tenant-to-object relationship.

detailed_observations.title: Validated that the behavior was gateway-level and not limited to a single endpoint.
detailed_observations.observation_description:
Root Cause
CORS validation uses permissive wildcard/regex logic maintained separately from the approved domain inventory.
Recommended Remediation
Replace dynamic reflection with an explicit allow-list of production and UAT origins. Disable credentialed CORS for APIs that do 
not require cross-origin browser access. Validate CORS rules in automated gateway tests.

detailed_observations.title: Compared behavior with the modern dashboard shell, which had a stronger header baseline.
detailed_observations.observation_description:
Root Cause
Security headers are configured at individual application routes rather than centrally at the reverse proxy or frontend gateway.
Recommended Remediation
Set secure defaults at the edge gateway: CSP with frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-
Policy with minimal capabilities, HSTS for production, and consistent X-Content-Type-Options.
